Run the same current-layer case_vcs_functional_sim and case_vcs_evidence_analyzer with the repaired generated source and all immutable semantic artifacts. Do not schedule dependent board gates or lower-layer revalidation before this closure.

The aggregate zero-output symptom and case_deadlock_axi_check token failures do not establish a hardware liveness or AXI root cause while the exact-board VCS compile is unresolved.

A compile repair alone cannot establish board correctness: complete Transformer-block weight binding, input/data order, 1792-beat shape/count, AXI protocol, lifecycle-frontier progress, target-model numeric comparison, and semantic evidence must still be produced by real tools.

Changing checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric tolerance, semantic testbench contract, wrapper source hashes, or model-tail boundaries would contaminate the repair and invalidate comparison.
